# s216 — Filter history by timezone-aware timestamp windows

Run reports need a time window without fetching and filtering the entire displayed history in a client.

**Findings:** agents feedback 2026-10-05 U7; docs/feedback/agents-2026-10-05.md · **Size:** S · **Tree:** slicer

**2026-10-06** — Ready for review: added inclusive --since and exclusive --until timezone-aware ISO8601 history windows, validating bounds before history reads and reporting invalid stored timestamps as corrupt. Preserved original timestamp strings, sorting, append-order ties, and schema. Updated command/agent references and changelog. Seven focused window tests passed; full unittest discovery passed 1278 tests with one skipped. affected.py exited 2 because the new worktree has no coverage map, so full discovery was run. Tracking check and git diff --check passed.

**Not in this slice:** history cursors, log schema changes, protection against clock skew, or changing stored timestamps and default log ordering.

## Why

cmd_log filters item/action/by before timestamp ordering and limiting. U7 needs since/until. The owner selected time windows only with an inclusive lower and exclusive upper bound.

## Files

CLI log parser/handler and shared timestamp helper if needed, history/log tests, command and agent references, and CHANGELOG.md.

## Failing tests

- Since includes an exactly equal instant; until excludes it. Z, explicit UTC offset and fractional seconds compare as instants.
- Time filters compose with item/action/by before limit; newest-first ordering and append-order ties stay unchanged.
- Missing bounds preserve current output. Empty windows succeed with an empty result; equal bounds are a valid empty window.
- Naive timestamps, malformed values and since > until fail with usage and no writes. A malformed stored timestamp encountered while time filtering is a named corrupt-state error, not a traceback or guessed instant.
- Windowed history survives interleaved union-merge append order; no per-entry cursor field is introduced.

## Implement

Add --since and --until, parse them with stdlib datetime, require a timezone, and normalize for comparisons. Apply since <= entry.when < until, with either bound optional. Filtering precedes the existing sort/limit step; emitted when strings remain the originals.

Validate supplied bounds before reading/filtering entries. Time filtering must fail clearly on a malformed entry timestamp rather than silently dropping it. Keep the default path's existing behavior and history schema. Document that timestamp windows cannot define an exact run boundary under clock skew.
